rulings.ruling: Ruling: defect fixed; model value kept. Under the last-month rule with a change of coverage type among the eligible months, the model applied rule 4 of the line 3 instructions ('If you were, or were considered, an eligible individual for the entire year and you changed your type of coverage during the year, enter ... the greater of' the chart and the December 1 maximum), giving $6,275; the project had used the December 1 maximum alone ($5,300). The project now applies rule 4 to the last-month rule's filer (f8889.line3_last_month, amb.2025.hsa_last_month_change), and stage11.hsa.last_month_changed asserts it.
